```{r Wrangle Orthologs}
# Extract P pacificus / C elegans 1-to-1 ortholog pairs
Orthologs <- CelegansPpacificus_dNdS_Table[, c("query_id", "subject_id")]

# Remove version numbers
Orthologs$query_id   <- str_replace(Orthologs$query_id, "\\.[^.]+$", "")
Orthologs$subject_id <- str_replace(Orthologs$subject_id, "\\.[^.]+$", "")

# Rename ortholog columns for clarity
colnames(Orthologs) <- c("Celegans_orthologR", "Ppacificus_orthologR")
```

```{r Setup Features to Test}
# Convert to data.table so `with = FALSE` works
ce_tbl <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants$SaxenaKonrad_2019_MA_Celegans_WS235
pp_tbl <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants$WellerWang_20142026_MA_Ppacificus_Elpaco
setDT(ce_tbl)
setDT(pp_tbl)

# Identify feature columns:
#   - expression
#   - dNdS
#   - GC_Length
#   - anything beginning with mean_
ce_feature_cols <- unique(c(
  "log2_Expression_Plus_One",
  "GC_Length",
  grep("^mean_", names(ce_tbl), value = TRUE)
))

pp_feature_cols <- unique(c(
  "log2_Expression_Plus_One",
  "GC_Length",
  grep("^mean_", names(pp_tbl), value = TRUE)
))

# Only keep features shared between species
shared_features <- intersect(ce_feature_cols, pp_feature_cols)

# Put expression first, then the rest
shared_features <- c(
  if ("log2_Expression_Plus_One" %in% shared_features) "log2_Expression_Plus_One" else character(0),
  setdiff(shared_features, "log2_Expression_Plus_One")
)

if (length(shared_features) == 0) {
  stop("No shared features found between species.")
}

message("Shared features to analyze:")
print(shared_features)
```

```{r Merge Features Together}
# Merge C. elegans features
ce_keep <- c(
  "GENE_ID",
  "transcript_id",
  "Overall_Expression_Group",
  "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  shared_features[shared_features %in% names(ce_tbl)]
)

ce_join <- ce_tbl[, ce_keep, with = FALSE]

setnames(
  ce_join,
  old = ce_keep,
  new = c(
    "Celegans_GENE_ID",
    "Celegans_orthologR",
    "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group",
    "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    paste0("Celegans_", shared_features[shared_features %in% names(ce_tbl)])
  )
)

Orthologs <- merge(
  Orthologs,
  ce_join,
  by = "Celegans_orthologR",
  all = FALSE
)

# Merge P. pacificus features
pp_keep <- c(
  "GENE_ID",
  "transcript_id",
  "Overall_Expression_Group",
  "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  shared_features[shared_features %in% names(pp_tbl)]
)

pp_join <- pp_tbl[, pp_keep, with = FALSE]

setnames(
  pp_join,
  old = pp_keep,
  new = c(
    "Ppacificus_GENE_ID",
    "Ppacificus_orthologR",
    "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group",
    "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    paste0("Ppacificus_", shared_features[shared_features %in% names(pp_tbl)])
  )
)

Orthologs <- merge(
  Orthologs,
  pp_join,
  by = "Ppacificus_orthologR",
  all = FALSE
)
```

```{r Codify Overall_Expression_Group into Ordered Numbers}
Orthologs <- Orthologs %>%
  mutate(
    Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 =
      as.integer(Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group) - 1,
    
    Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 =
      as.integer(Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group) - 1
  )

# And Add Single Column Stating Expression Group Numbers
Orthologs <-
  Orthologs %>% 
  mutate(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group = 
           paste(Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
                 Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
                 sep = ">"))

# And Add Single Column Stating Expression Group Numbers
Orthologs <-
  Orthologs %>% 
  mutate(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change = 
           Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 -
           Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5)
```

```{r Setting Up Iterative Function}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(clinfun)

setDT(Orthologs)

run_feature_analysis <- function(DT_in, feature_name, results_dir) {

  ce_col <- paste0("Celegans_", feature_name)
  pp_col <- paste0("Ppacificus_", feature_name)

  req_cols <- c(
    ce_col,
    pp_col,
    "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"
  )

  do_cross_group_plot <- identical(feature_name, "log2_Expression_Plus_One")
  if (do_cross_group_plot) {
    req_cols <- c(
      req_cols,
      "CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group",
      "CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change",
      "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5"
    )
  }

  if (!all(req_cols %in% names(DT_in))) {
    message("Skipping ", feature_name, " because one or more columns are missing.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  DT <- copy(DT_in)[complete.cases(DT_in[, ..req_cols])]

  if (nrow(DT) < 10) {
    message("Skipping ", feature_name, " because too few complete observations remain.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  save_plot <- function(p, file, w, h) {
    if (!is.null(p)) ggsave(file, plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Percentiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  DT[, `:=`(
    feat_rank_ce = rank(get(ce_col), ties.method = "average"),
    feat_rank_pp = rank(get(pp_col), ties.method = "average"),
    mut_rank_ce  = rank(Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average"),
    mut_rank_pp  = rank(Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average")
  )]

  DT[, `:=`(
    feat_pct_ce = feat_rank_ce / .N,
    feat_pct_pp = feat_rank_pp / .N,
    mut_pct_ce  = mut_rank_ce / .N,
    mut_pct_pp  = mut_rank_pp / .N
  )]

  # delta = Ppa relative to Cel
  DT[, `:=`(
    delta_feature = feat_pct_pp - feat_pct_ce,
    delta_mut     = mut_pct_pp - mut_pct_ce
  )]

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scatter plot + Spearman correlation
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cor_test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(DT$delta_feature, DT$delta_mut, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  p_scatter <-
    ggplot(DT, aes(x = delta_feature, y = delta_mut)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "white",
      fill = "black",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "purple", fill = "orange") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Delta ", feature_name, " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ",
        round(as.numeric(cor_test$estimate), 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(cor_test$p.value, 3)
      ),
      fill  = "Correlation (rho)",
      subtitle = "Each point represents an ortholog with embryonic expression",
      caption = "Dashed lines = zero; smooth = LOESS; point size reflects significance"
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5 equal-sized bins on delta_feature
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  qs <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(DT$delta_feature, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)))

  bin_summary <- NULL
  p_bins <- NULL

  if (length(qs) >= 2) {
    DT[, feature_bin := cut(delta_feature, breaks = qs, include.lowest = TRUE)]

    bin_summary <- DT[, .(
      mean_delta_mut = mean(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = .N
    ), by = feature_bin]

    bin_summary[, bin_mid := sapply(strsplit(as.character(feature_bin), ","), function(x) {
      vals <- as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]|\\(|\\)", "", x))
      mean(vals)
    })]

    bin_summary <- bin_summary[order(bin_mid)]

    p_bins <-
      ggplot(bin_summary, aes(x = bin_mid, y = mean_delta_mut)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        x = paste0("Binned delta ", feature_name, " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        y = paste0("Mean delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = paste0("Binned relationship: ", feature_name)
      )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Comparing extremes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  low  <- DT$delta_mut[DT$delta_feature <= -0.6]
  high <- DT$delta_mut[DT$delta_feature >= 0.6]

  wilcox_test <- NULL
  p_extreme <- NULL

  if (length(low) > 0 && length(high) > 0) {
    wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(low, high)

    extreme_df <- data.frame(
      group = rep(c("Most negative delta feature", "Most positive delta feature"),
                  c(length(low), length(high))),
      delta_mut = c(low, high)
    )

    p_extreme <-
      ggplot(extreme_df, aes(x = group, y = delta_mut, fill = group, colour = group)) +
      geom_violin() +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("orange", alpha = .4),
                                   alpha("purple", alpha = .4))) +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_test$p.value, 3))
      )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Equal-size bins for ordered boxplot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  n_bins <- min(5, length(unique(DT$delta_feature)))

  p_binned <- NULL
  jt <- NULL

  if (n_bins >= 2) {
    DT <- DT %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = as.character(ggplot2::cut_number(delta_feature, n = n_bins))
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = str_replace_all(
          Feature_Change_Group,
          "\\d+\\.?\\d*e[-+]?\\d+",
          ~ format(as.numeric(.x), scientific = FALSE, digits = 6)
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = forcats::fct_reorder(
          factor(Feature_Change_Group, ordered = TRUE),
          as.numeric(str_extract(Feature_Change_Group, "(?<=\\[|\\()[^,]+")),
          .fun = min,
          .desc = FALSE
        )
      )

    jt <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
      DT$delta_mut,
      DT$Feature_Change_Group,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )

    p_binned <-
      ggplot(DT, aes(x = Feature_Change_Group, y = delta_mut, fill = Feature_Change_Group)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "Jonckheere = ",
          round(jt$statistic, 3),
          ", p = ",
          round(jt$p.value, 3)
        )
      ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(
        c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
      )(length(unique(DT$Feature_Change_Group)))) +
      guides(fill = "none")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extra analysis only for log2_Expression_Plus_One
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cross_group_test <- NULL
  cross_group_change_test <- NULL
  lm_model <- NULL
  spearman_change <- NULL
  jt_change <- NULL
  summary_df_trend <- NULL

  p_cross_group <- NULL
  p_cross_group_change <- NULL
  p_direction_group <- NULL
  p_trend <- NULL

  p_terminal_5 <- NULL
  p_terminal_0 <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_5 <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_0 <- NULL

  p_direction_test <- NULL

  if (do_cross_group_plot) {

    # 1) Boxplot of delta_mut by CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group
    #    excluding no-change cases like 5>5, 0>0, etc.
    DT_plot <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
    ]

    if (nrow(DT_plot) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_plot$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group) > 1) {
      cross_group_test <- kruskal.test(
        delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group,
        data = DT_plot
      )

      pal_fun <- function(n) colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(n)

      # Create intuitive labels: [Cel] X > [Ppa] Y
      DT_plot[, CrossSpecies_Label := paste0(
        "[Cel] ",
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
        " > [Ppa] ",
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
      )]

      grp <- forcats::fct_reorder(
        factor(DT_plot$CrossSpecies_Label),
        DT_plot$delta_mut,
        .fun = median
      )

      cols <- setNames(pal_fun(nlevels(grp)), levels(grp))

      p_cross_group <-
        ggplot(DT_plot, aes(
          x = grp,
          y = delta_mut,
          fill = grp,
          colour = grp
        )) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        discrete_scale("colour", "custom_colour", palette = pal_fun) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
        labs(
          x = "Expression group transition ([Cel] -> [Ppa])",
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "Kruskal-Wallis p = ",
            signif(cross_group_test$p.value, 3)
          )
        )
    }

    # 2) Boxplot of delta_mut by numeric expression-group change
    DT_plot2 <- DT[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change != 0]

    if (nrow(DT_plot2) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_plot2$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {
      cross_group_change_test <- kruskal.test(
        delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
        data = DT_plot2
      )

      pal_fun <- function(n) colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(n)

      p_cross_group_change <-
        ggplot(DT_plot2, aes(
          x = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
          y = delta_mut,
          colour = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
          fill = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
          group = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change)
        )) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        discrete_scale("fill", "custom_fill", palette = pal_fun) +
        discrete_scale("colour", "custom_colour", palette = pal_fun) +
        labs(
          x = paste0("Expression group change (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(cross_group_change_test$p.value, 3))
        )
    }

    # 3) Directional boxplot: Up in Ppa relative to Cel vs Down in Ppa relative to Cel
    DT_direction <- DT[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change != 0]

    if (nrow(DT_direction) > 0 && uniqueN(sign(DT_direction$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change)) > 1) {
      DT_direction[, Direction_Group := fifelse(
        CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change > 0,
        "Up in Ppa relative to Cel",
        "Down in Ppa relative to Cel"
      )]

      DT_direction[, Direction_Group := factor(
        Direction_Group,
        levels = c("Down in Ppa relative to Cel", "Up in Ppa relative to Cel")
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_direction$Direction_Group) == 2) {
        p_direction_test <- wilcox.test(delta_mut ~ Direction_Group, data = DT_direction)

        p_direction_group <-
          ggplot(DT_direction, aes(
            x = Direction_Group,
            y = delta_mut,
            fill = Direction_Group,
            colour = Direction_Group
          )) +
           geom_violin() +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("orange", alpha = .4),
                                   alpha("purple", alpha = .4))) +
          labs(
            x = "Expression group direction (in Ppa relative to Cel)",
            y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(p_direction_test$p.value, 3))
          )
      }
    }

    # 4) Terminal-state violin plots for 5
    DT_terminal_5 <- DT[
      (Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 & Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 5) |
        (Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 & Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 5)
    ]

    if (nrow(DT_terminal_5) > 0) {
      DT_terminal_5[, terminal_group := fifelse(
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5,
        "Pp 5, Ce != 5",
        "Ce 5, Pp != 5"
      )]

      DT_terminal_5[, terminal_group := factor(
        terminal_group,
        levels = c("Pp 5, Ce != 5", "Ce 5, Pp != 5")
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_terminal_5$terminal_group) == 2) {
        wilcox_terminal_5 <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ terminal_group,
          data = DT_terminal_5
        )

        p_terminal_5 <-
          ggplot(DT_terminal_5, aes(
            x = terminal_group,
            y = delta_mut,
            fill = terminal_group,
            colour = terminal_group
          )) +
          geom_violin() +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("orange", alpha = .4),
                                   alpha("purple", alpha = .4))) +
          labs(
            x = "",
            y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_terminal_5$p.value, 3))
          )
      }
    }

    # 5) Terminal-state violin plots for 0
    DT_terminal_0 <- DT[
      (Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 & Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 0) |
        (Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 & Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 0)
    ]

    if (nrow(DT_terminal_0) > 0) {
      DT_terminal_0[, terminal_group := fifelse(
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0,
        "Pp 0, Ce != 0",
        "Ce 0, Pp != 0"
      )]

      DT_terminal_0[, terminal_group := factor(
        terminal_group,
        levels = c("Pp 0, Ce != 0", "Ce 0, Pp != 0")
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_terminal_0$terminal_group) == 2) {
        wilcox_terminal_0 <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ terminal_group,
          data = DT_terminal_0
        )

        p_terminal_0 <-
          ggplot(DT_terminal_0, aes(
            x = terminal_group,
            y = delta_mut,
            fill = terminal_group,
            colour = terminal_group
          )) +
           geom_violin() +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("orange", alpha = .4),
                                   alpha("purple", alpha = .4))) +
          labs(
            x = "",
            y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_terminal_0$p.value, 3))
          )
      }
    }

    # 6) Trend / regression plot for numeric expression-group change
    DT_trend <- DT[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change != 0]

    if (nrow(DT_trend) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {
      lm_model <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
        data = DT_trend
      )

      spearman_change <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(
          DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
          DT_trend$delta_mut,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )
      )

      jt_change <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
        DT_trend$delta_mut,
        factor(DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change, ordered = TRUE),
        alternative = "two.sided"
      )

      summary_df_trend <- DT_trend[, .(
        mean_delta = mean(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE),
        se = if (.N > 1) sd(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N) else NA_real_,
        n = .N
      ), by = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change][order(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change)]

      p_trend <-
        ggplot(summary_df_trend, aes(
          x = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
          y = mean_delta
        )) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_point() +
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(ymin = mean_delta - se, ymax = mean_delta + se),
          alpha = 0.2,
          colour = NA
        ) +
        
        labs(
          x = paste0("Expression group change (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          y = paste0("Mean delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "LM slope = ",
            round(coef(lm_model)[2], 3),
            ", p = ",
            signif(summary(lm_model)$coefficients[2, 4], 3)
          )
        )
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save outputs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  safe_name <- str_replace_all(feature_name, "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_")
  prefix <- file.path(results_dir, safe_name)

  save_plot(p_scatter, paste0(prefix, "_scatter.png"), 6.5, 5.5)

  if (!is.null(p_bins)) {
    save_plot(p_bins, paste0(prefix, "_binned_mean.png"), 6.5, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_extreme)) {
    save_plot(p_extreme, paste0(prefix, "_extremes.png"), 5.5, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_binned)) {
    save_plot(p_binned, paste0(prefix, "_ordered_bins.png"), 7.0, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_cross_group)) {
    save_plot(p_cross_group, paste0(prefix, "_cross_species_expression_group_boxplot.png"), 10, 4.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_cross_group_change)) {
    save_plot(p_cross_group_change, paste0(prefix, "_cross_species_expression_group_change_boxplot.png"), 10, 4.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_direction_group)) {
    save_plot(p_direction_group, paste0(prefix, "_expression_direction_boxplot.png"), 4, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_trend)) {
    save_plot(p_trend, paste0(prefix, "_cross_species_expression_group_trend.png"), 7.0, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_terminal_5)) {
    save_plot(p_terminal_5, paste0(prefix, "_terminal_5_violin.png"), 4, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_terminal_0)) {
    save_plot(p_terminal_0, paste0(prefix, "_terminal_0_violin.png"), 4, 5.5)
  }

  fwrite(
    as.data.table(DT),
    paste0(prefix, "_full_data.csv")
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  list(
    feature = feature_name,
    n = nrow(DT),
    spearman_rho = as.numeric(cor_test$estimate),
    spearman_p = cor_test$p.value,
    wilcox_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_test)) wilcox_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    jonckheere_statistic = if (!is.null(jt)) as.numeric(jt$statistic) else NA_real_,
    jonckheere_p = if (!is.null(jt)) jt$p.value else NA_real_,

    cross_group_p = if (!is.null(cross_group_test)) cross_group_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    cross_group_change_p = if (!is.null(cross_group_change_test)) cross_group_change_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    direction_group_p = if (!is.null(p_direction_test)) p_direction_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    lm_slope = if (!is.null(lm_model)) coef(lm_model)[2] else NA_real_,
    lm_p = if (!is.null(lm_model)) summary(lm_model)$coefficients[2, 4] else NA_real_,
    spearman_change_p = if (!is.null(spearman_change)) spearman_change$p.value else NA_real_,
    jt_change_p = if (!is.null(jt_change)) jt_change$p.value else NA_real_,

    wilcox_terminal_5_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_5)) wilcox_terminal_5$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_terminal_0_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_0)) wilcox_terminal_0$p.value else NA_real_,

    data = DT,
    cor_test = cor_test,
    p_scatter = p_scatter,
    bin_summary = bin_summary,
    p_bins = p_bins,
    wilcox_test = wilcox_test,
    p_extreme = p_extreme,
    p_binned = p_binned,
    p_cross_group = p_cross_group,
    p_cross_group_change = p_cross_group_change,
    p_direction_group = p_direction_group,
    p_trend = p_trend,
    p_terminal_5 = p_terminal_5,
    p_terminal_0 = p_terminal_0,
    summary_df_trend = summary_df_trend
  )
}
```

```{r Running the Function}
feature_results <- list()
summary_table <- list()

for (feat in shared_features) {
  message("Processing: ", feat)
  res <- run_feature_analysis(Orthologs, feat, results_dir)
  feature_results[[feat]] <- res

  if (!is.null(res)) {
    summary_table[[feat]] <- data.table(
      feature = res$feature,
      n = res$n,
      spearman_rho = res$spearman_rho,
      spearman_p = res$spearman_p,
      wilcox_p = res$wilcox_p,
      jonckheere_statistic = res$jonckheere_statistic,
      jonckheere_p = res$jonckheere_p
    )

    print(res$cor_test)
    print(res$p_scatter)
    if (!is.null(res$p_bins)) print(res$p_bins)
    if (!is.null(res$p_extreme)) print(res$p_extreme)
    if (!is.null(res$p_binned)) print(res$p_binned)
  }
}

if (length(summary_table) > 0) {
  summary_dt <- rbindlist(summary_table, fill = TRUE)
  fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(results_dir, "feature_association_summary.csv"))
  saveRDS(feature_results, file.path(results_dir, "feature_association_results.rds"))
  summary_dt
} else {
  summary_dt <- data.table()
  summary_dt
}
```

```{r Testing}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(clinfun)

setDT(Orthologs)

run_feature_analysis <- function(DT_in, feature_name, results_dir) {

  ce_col <- paste0("Celegans_", feature_name)
  pp_col <- paste0("Ppacificus_", feature_name)

  req_cols <- c(
    ce_col,
    pp_col,
    "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"
  )

  do_cross_group_plot <- identical(feature_name, "log2_Expression_Plus_One")
  if (do_cross_group_plot) {
    req_cols <- c(
      req_cols,
      "CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group",
      "CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change",
      "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5"
    )
  }

  if (!all(req_cols %in% names(DT_in))) {
    message("Skipping ", feature_name, " because one or more columns are missing.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  DT <- copy(DT_in)[complete.cases(DT_in[, ..req_cols])]

  if (nrow(DT) < 10) {
    message("Skipping ", feature_name, " because too few complete observations remain.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  save_plot <- function(p, file, w, h) {
    if (!is.null(p)) ggsave(file, plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Percentiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  DT[, `:=`(
    feat_rank_ce = rank(get(ce_col), ties.method = "average"),
    feat_rank_pp = rank(get(pp_col), ties.method = "average"),
    mut_rank_ce  = rank(Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average"),
    mut_rank_pp  = rank(Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average")
  )]

  DT[, `:=`(
    feat_pct_ce = feat_rank_ce / .N,
    feat_pct_pp = feat_rank_pp / .N,
    mut_pct_ce  = mut_rank_ce / .N,
    mut_pct_pp  = mut_rank_pp / .N
  )]

  # delta = Ppa relative to Cel
  DT[, `:=`(
    delta_feature = feat_pct_pp - feat_pct_ce,
    delta_mut     = mut_pct_pp - mut_pct_ce
  )]

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scatter plot + Spearman correlation
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cor_test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(DT$delta_feature, DT$delta_mut, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  p_scatter <-
    ggplot(DT, aes(x = delta_feature, y = delta_mut)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "white",
      fill = "black",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "purple", fill = "orange") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Delta ", feature_name, " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ",
        round(as.numeric(cor_test$estimate), 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(cor_test$p.value, 3)
      ),
      fill  = "Correlation (rho)",
      subtitle = "Each point represents an ortholog with embryonic expression",
      caption = "Dashed lines = zero; smooth = LOESS; point size reflects significance"
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5 equal-sized bins on delta_feature
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  qs <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(DT$delta_feature, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)))

  bin_summary <- NULL
  p_bins <- NULL

  if (length(qs) >= 2) {
    DT[, feature_bin := cut(delta_feature, breaks = qs, include.lowest = TRUE)]

    bin_summary <- DT[, .(
      mean_delta_mut = mean(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = .N
    ), by = feature_bin]

    bin_summary[, bin_mid := sapply(strsplit(as.character(feature_bin), ","), function(x) {
      vals <- as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]|\\(|\\)", "", x))
      mean(vals)
    })]

    bin_summary <- bin_summary[order(bin_mid)]

    p_bins <-
      ggplot(bin_summary, aes(x = bin_mid, y = mean_delta_mut)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      
      labs(
        x = paste0("Binned delta ", feature_name, " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        y = paste0("Mean delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = paste0("Binned relationship: ", feature_name)
      )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Comparing extremes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  low  <- DT$delta_mut[DT$delta_feature <= -0.6]
  high <- DT$delta_mut[DT$delta_feature >= 0.6]

  wilcox_test <- NULL
  p_extreme <- NULL

  if (length(low) > 0 && length(high) > 0) {
    wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(low, high)

    extreme_df <- data.frame(
      group = rep(c("Most negative delta feature", "Most positive delta feature"),
                  c(length(low), length(high))),
      delta_mut = c(low, high)
    )

    p_extreme <-
      ggplot(extreme_df, aes(x = group, y = delta_mut, fill = group, colour = group)) +
      geom_violin() +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      theme_bw() +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(alpha("orange", alpha = .4),
                                   alpha("purple", alpha = .4))) +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_test$p.value, 3))
      )
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Equal-size bins for ordered boxplot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  n_bins <- min(5, length(unique(DT$delta_feature)))

  p_binned <- NULL
  jt <- NULL

  if (n_bins >= 2) {
    DT <- DT %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = as.character(ggplot2::cut_number(delta_feature, n = n_bins))
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = str_replace_all(
          Feature_Change_Group,
          "\\d+\\.?\\d*e[-+]?\\d+",
          ~ format(as.numeric(.x), scientific = FALSE, digits = 6)
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = forcats::fct_reorder(
          factor(Feature_Change_Group, ordered = TRUE),
          as.numeric(str_extract(Feature_Change_Group, "(?<=\\[|\\()[^,]+")),
          .fun = min,
          .desc = FALSE
        )
      )

    jt <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
      DT$delta_mut,
      DT$Feature_Change_Group,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )

    p_binned <-
      ggplot(DT, aes(x = Feature_Change_Group, y = delta_mut, fill = Feature_Change_Group)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "Jonckheere = ",
          round(jt$statistic, 3),
          ", p = ",
          round(jt$p.value, 3)
        )
      ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(
        c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
      )(length(unique(DT$Feature_Change_Group)))) +
      guides(fill = "none")
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Extra analysis only for log2_Expression_Plus_One
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cross_group_test <- NULL
  cross_group_change_test <- NULL
  lm_model <- NULL
  spearman_change <- NULL
  jt_change <- NULL
  summary_df_trend <- NULL

  p_cross_group <- NULL
  p_cross_group_change <- NULL
  p_trend <- NULL

  p_terminal_5 <- NULL
  p_terminal_0 <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_5 <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_0 <- NULL

  if (do_cross_group_plot) {

    # 1) Boxplot of delta_mut by CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group
    #    excluding no-change cases like 5>5, 0>0, etc.
    DT_plot <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
    ]

    if (nrow(DT_plot) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_plot$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group) > 1) {
      cross_group_test <- kruskal.test(
        delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group,
        data = DT_plot
      )

      pal_fun <- function(n) colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(n)

      # Create intuitive labels: [Cel] X > [Ppa] Y
      DT_plot[, CrossSpecies_Label := paste0(
        "[Cel] ",
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
        " > [Ppa] ",
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
      )]

      grp <- forcats::fct_reorder(
        factor(DT_plot$CrossSpecies_Label),
        DT_plot$delta_mut,
        .fun = median
      )

      cols <- setNames(pal_fun(nlevels(grp)), levels(grp))

      p_cross_group <-
        ggplot(DT_plot, aes(
          x = grp,
          y = delta_mut,
          fill = grp,
          colour = grp
        )) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        discrete_scale("colour", "custom_colour", palette = pal_fun) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
        labs(
          x = "Expression group transition ([Cel] -> [Ppa])",
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "Kruskal-Wallis p = ",
            signif(cross_group_test$p.value, 3)
          )
        )
    }

    # 2) Boxplot of delta_mut by numeric expression-group change
    DT_plot2 <- DT[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change != 0]

    if (nrow(DT_plot2) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_plot2$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {
      cross_group_change_test <- kruskal.test(
        delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
        data = DT_plot2
      )

      pal_fun <- function(n) colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(n)

      p_cross_group_change <-
        ggplot(DT_plot2, aes(
          x = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
          y = delta_mut,
          colour = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
          fill = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
          group = factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change)
        )) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = .7) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        discrete_scale("fill", "custom_fill", palette = pal_fun) +
        discrete_scale("colour", "custom_colour", palette = pal_fun) +
        labs(
          x = paste0("Expression group change (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(cross_group_change_test$p.value, 3))
        )
    }

    # 3) Terminal-state violin plots for 5
    DT_terminal_5 <- DT[
      (Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 & Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 5) |
        (Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 & Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 5)
    ]

    if (nrow(DT_terminal_5) > 0) {
      DT_terminal_5[, terminal_group := fifelse(
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5,
        "Pp 5, Ce != 5",
        "Ce 5, Pp != 5"
      )]

      DT_terminal_5[, terminal_group := factor(
        terminal_group,
        levels = c("Pp 5, Ce != 5", "Ce 5, Pp != 5")
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_terminal_5$terminal_group) == 2) {
        wilcox_terminal_5 <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ terminal_group,
          data = DT_terminal_5
        )

        p_terminal_5 <-
          ggplot(DT_terminal_5, aes(
            x = terminal_group,
            y = delta_mut,
            fill = terminal_group,
            colour = terminal_group
          )) +
          geom_violin() +
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
          scale_colour_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
          labs(
            x = "",
            y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_terminal_5$p.value, 3))
          )
      }
    }

    # 4) Terminal-state violin plots for 0
    DT_terminal_0 <- DT[
      (Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 & Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 0) |
        (Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 & Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 0)
    ]

    if (nrow(DT_terminal_0) > 0) {
      DT_terminal_0[, terminal_group := fifelse(
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0,
        "Pp 0, Ce != 0",
        "Ce 0, Pp != 0"
      )]

      DT_terminal_0[, terminal_group := factor(
        terminal_group,
        levels = c("Pp 0, Ce != 0", "Ce 0, Pp != 0")
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_terminal_0$terminal_group) == 2) {
        wilcox_terminal_0 <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ terminal_group,
          data = DT_terminal_0
        )

        p_terminal_0 <-
          ggplot(DT_terminal_0, aes(
            x = terminal_group,
            y = delta_mut,
            fill = terminal_group,
            colour = terminal_group
          )) +
          geom_violin() +
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          
          scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
          scale_colour_manual(values = c("orange", "purple")) +
          labs(
            x = "",
            y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            title = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(wilcox_terminal_0$p.value, 3))
          )
      }
    }

    # 5) Trend / regression plot for numeric expression-group change
    if (nrow(DT_plot2) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_plot2$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {
      DT_trend <- DT[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change != 0]

      if (nrow(DT_trend) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {
        lm_model <- lm(
          delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
          data = DT_trend
        )

        spearman_change <- suppressWarnings(
          cor.test(
            DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
            DT_trend$delta_mut,
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )
        )

        jt_change <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
          DT_trend$delta_mut,
          factor(DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change, ordered = TRUE),
          alternative = "two.sided"
        )

        summary_df_trend <- DT_trend[, .(
          mean_delta = mean(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE),
          se = if (.N > 1) sd(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(.N) else NA_real_,
          n = .N
        ), by = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change][order(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change)]

        p_trend <-
          ggplot(summary_df_trend, aes(
            x = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
            y = mean_delta
          )) +
          geom_line() +
          geom_point() +
          geom_ribbon(
            aes(ymin = mean_delta - se, ymax = mean_delta + se),
            alpha = 0.2,
            colour = NA
          ) +
          
          labs(
            x = paste0("Expression group change (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            y = paste0("Mean delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
            title = paste0(
              "LM slope = ",
              round(coef(lm_model)[2], 3),
              ", p = ",
              signif(summary(lm_model)$coefficients[2, 4], 3)
            )
          )
      }
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save outputs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  safe_name <- str_replace_all(feature_name, "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_")
  prefix <- file.path(results_dir, safe_name)

  save_plot(p_scatter, paste0(prefix, "_scatter.png"), 6.5, 5.5)

  if (!is.null(p_bins)) {
    save_plot(p_bins, paste0(prefix, "_binned_mean.png"), 6.5, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_extreme)) {
    save_plot(p_extreme, paste0(prefix, "_extremes.png"), 5.5, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_binned)) {
    save_plot(p_binned, paste0(prefix, "_ordered_bins.png"), 7.0, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_cross_group)) {
    save_plot(p_cross_group, paste0(prefix, "_cross_species_expression_group_boxplot.png"), 10, 4.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_cross_group_change)) {
    save_plot(p_cross_group_change, paste0(prefix, "_cross_species_expression_group_change_boxplot.png"), 10, 4.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_trend)) {
    save_plot(p_trend, paste0(prefix, "_cross_species_expression_group_trend.png"), 7.0, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_terminal_5)) {
    save_plot(p_terminal_5, paste0(prefix, "_terminal_5_violin.png"), 4, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_terminal_0)) {
    save_plot(p_terminal_0, paste0(prefix, "_terminal_0_violin.png"), 4, 5.5)
  }

  fwrite(
    as.data.table(DT),
    paste0(prefix, "_full_data.csv")
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  list(
    feature = feature_name,
    n = nrow(DT),
    spearman_rho = as.numeric(cor_test$estimate),
    spearman_p = cor_test$p.value,
    wilcox_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_test)) wilcox_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    jonckheere_statistic = if (!is.null(jt)) as.numeric(jt$statistic) else NA_real_,
    jonckheere_p = if (!is.null(jt)) jt$p.value else NA_real_,

    cross_group_p = if (!is.null(cross_group_test)) cross_group_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    cross_group_change_p = if (!is.null(cross_group_change_test)) cross_group_change_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    lm_slope = if (!is.null(lm_model)) coef(lm_model)[2] else NA_real_,
    lm_p = if (!is.null(lm_model)) summary(lm_model)$coefficients[2, 4] else NA_real_,
    spearman_change_p = if (!is.null(spearman_change)) spearman_change$p.value else NA_real_,
    jt_change_p = if (!is.null(jt_change)) jt_change$p.value else NA_real_,

    wilcox_terminal_5_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_5)) wilcox_terminal_5$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_terminal_0_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_0)) wilcox_terminal_0$p.value else NA_real_,

    data = DT,
    cor_test = cor_test,
    p_scatter = p_scatter,
    bin_summary = bin_summary,
    p_bins = p_bins,
    wilcox_test = wilcox_test,
    p_extreme = p_extreme,
    p_binned = p_binned,
    p_cross_group = p_cross_group,
    p_cross_group_change = p_cross_group_change,
    p_trend = p_trend,
    p_terminal_5 = p_terminal_5,
    p_terminal_0 = p_terminal_0,
    summary_df_trend = summary_df_trend
  )
}
```

```{r LASSO}
# Build a single delta dataset from the merged ortholog table
DT_lasso <- copy(Orthologs)

# Remove dNdS from the LASSO predictors
lasso_features <- shared_features

# Keep only columns needed to compute all deltas plus mutation rate
lasso_keep_cols <- c(
  "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  paste0("Celegans_", lasso_features),
  paste0("Ppacificus_", lasso_features)
)

DT_lasso <- DT_lasso[complete.cases(DT_lasso[, ..lasso_keep_cols])]

# Compute percentile-based deltas for every LASSO feature
for (feat in lasso_features) {
  ce_col <- paste0("Celegans_", feat)
  pp_col <- paste0("Ppacificus_", feat)

  DT_lasso[, paste0("rank_ce_", feat) := rank(get(ce_col), ties.method = "average")]
  DT_lasso[, paste0("rank_pp_", feat) := rank(get(pp_col), ties.method = "average")]

  DT_lasso[, paste0("pct_ce_", feat) := get(paste0("rank_ce_", feat)) / .N]
  DT_lasso[, paste0("pct_pp_", feat) := get(paste0("rank_pp_", feat)) / .N]

  # delta = Ppa relative to Cel
  DT_lasso[, paste0("delta_", feat) := get(paste0("pct_pp_", feat)) - get(paste0("pct_ce_", feat))]
}

DT_lasso[, delta_mut :=
  rank(Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average") / .N -
  rank(Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average") / .N
]

# Predictors for LASSO
delta_cols <- grep("^delta_", names(DT_lasso), value = TRUE)
predictors <- setdiff(delta_cols, "delta_mut")

# Drop zero-variance predictors
pred_sds <- sapply(DT_lasso[, ..predictors], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
predictors <- names(pred_sds)[is.finite(pred_sds) & pred_sds > 0]

if (length(predictors) < 2) {
  stop("Too few usable delta predictors remain for LASSO.")
}

# Train/test split
set.seed(69)
index <- createDataPartition(DT_lasso$delta_mut, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_df <- DT_lasso[index]
test_df  <- DT_lasso[-index]

# Prepare matrices
x_train_raw <- as.data.frame(train_df[, ..predictors])
x_test_raw  <- as.data.frame(test_df[, ..predictors])

X_train <- scale(x_train_raw)
X_test <- scale(
  x_test_raw,
  center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"),
  scale  = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale")
)

y_train <- train_df$delta_mut
y_test  <- test_df$delta_mut

# Cross-validated LASSO
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = as.matrix(X_train),
  y = y_train,
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

# Evaluate
pred_test <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min", newx = as.matrix(X_test)))
test_R2 <- cor(pred_test, y_test)^2
test_RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y_test - pred_test)^2))

# LASSO coefficients
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(coef_mat),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coef_mat[, 1]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)")

# ----------------------------
# Compute Spearman coefficients and p-values on deltas
# ----------------------------
spearman_plot_df <- lapply(predictors, function(v) {
  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      DT_lasso[[v]],
      DT_lasso$delta_mut,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  data.frame(
    variable = gsub("^delta_", "", v),
    coefficient = as.numeric(ct$estimate),
    p_value = pmax(ct$p.value, 1e-300),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    logp = pmin(-log10(p_value), 20),
    test = "Spearman",
    sign = ifelse(coefficient >= 0, "pos", "neg")
  )

# ----------------------------
# Clean LASSO coefficients
# ----------------------------
lasso_plot_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(
    variable = gsub("^delta_", "", variable),
    test = "LASSO"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    spearman_plot_df %>% select(variable, spearman_coef = coefficient, p_value, logp),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(logp)) %>%
  mutate(
    logp = pmin(logp, 20),
    sign = ifelse(spearman_coef >= 0, "pos", "neg")
  )

# Keep only shared variables
common_vars <- intersect(lasso_plot_df$variable, spearman_plot_df$variable)
lasso_plot_df <- lasso_plot_df %>% filter(variable %in% common_vars)
spearman_plot_df <- spearman_plot_df %>% filter(variable %in% common_vars)

# ----------------------------
# Normalise coefficients (within each test)
# ----------------------------
lasso_plot_df <- lasso_plot_df %>%
  group_by(test) %>%
  mutate(coef_norm = coefficient / max(abs(coefficient), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

spearman_plot_df <- spearman_plot_df %>%
  group_by(test) %>%
  mutate(coef_norm = coefficient / max(abs(coefficient), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Order EVERYTHING by Spearman coefficient
# ----------------------------
var_levels <- spearman_plot_df %>%
  arrange(coefficient) %>%
  pull(variable)

lasso_plot_df$variable <- factor(lasso_plot_df$variable, levels = var_levels)
spearman_plot_df$variable <- factor(spearman_plot_df$variable, levels = var_levels)

# ----------------------------
# Combine
# ----------------------------
combined_df <- bind_rows(
  lasso_plot_df %>% select(variable, coefficient, coef_norm, p_value, logp, sign, test),
  spearman_plot_df %>% select(variable, coefficient, coef_norm, p_value, logp, sign, test)
)

# Ensure facet order: Spearman on the left, LASSO on the right
combined_df$test <- factor(combined_df$test, levels = c("Spearman", "LASSO"))

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
lasso_plot <-
  ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = variable, y = coef_norm)) +

  geom_col(
    data = subset(combined_df, sign == "neg"),
    aes(fill = logp),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "orange",
    high = "#ff1f00",
    name = expression(-log[10](p))
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  geom_col(
    data = subset(combined_df, sign == "pos"),
    aes(fill = logp),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#a6d96a",
    high = "#006837",
    name = expression(-log[10](p))
  ) +

  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(~test, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Drivers of Delta Mutation Percentile",
    subtitle = paste0("Test R² = ", round(test_R2, 4), " | RMSE = ", round(test_RMSE, 4), " | Delta features are oriented ", delta_phrase),
    x = "Feature (ordered by Spearman)",
    y = "Normalised coefficient (within test)"
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)

lasso_plot

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "delta_LASSO_Spearman_ordered_by_spearman.png"),
  plot = lasso_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 2000,
  bg = "transparent"
)
```

```{r Replacing delta Mutation Rate with Other Outcomes}
# ============================================================
# Add ortholog divergence / similarity metrics back into Orthologs
# ============================================================
ortholog_metric_cols <- intersect(
  c("dN", "dS", "dNdS", "perc_identity", "ppos"),
  names(CelegansPpacificus_dNdS_Table)
)

if (length(ortholog_metric_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No ortholog metric columns found in CelegansPpacificus_dNdS_Table.")
}

ortholog_metrics <- CelegansPpacificus_dNdS_Table[, c("query_id", "subject_id", ortholog_metric_cols), with = FALSE]
ortholog_metrics <- as.data.table(ortholog_metrics)

ortholog_metrics$query_id   <- str_replace(ortholog_metrics$query_id, "\\.[^.]+$", "")
ortholog_metrics$subject_id <- str_replace(ortholog_metrics$subject_id, "\\.[^.]+$", "")

setnames(
  ortholog_metrics,
  old = c("query_id", "subject_id"),
  new = c("Celegans_orthologR", "Ppacificus_orthologR")
)

Orthologs <- merge(
  Orthologs,
  ortholog_metrics,
  by = c("Celegans_orthologR", "Ppacificus_orthologR"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

# ============================================================
# Choose predictors and outcomes
#   - remove dS, dN, dNdS, perc_identity, ppos from predictors
#   - keep delta_mut as an outcome again
# ============================================================
analysis_features <- setdiff(
  shared_features,
  c("dS", "dN", "dNdS", "perc_identity", "ppos")
)

analysis_features <- c(
  if ("log2_Expression_Plus_One" %in% analysis_features) "log2_Expression_Plus_One" else character(0),
  setdiff(analysis_features, "log2_Expression_Plus_One")
)

outcomes <- c(
  "delta_mut",
  intersect(c("dS", "dN", "dNdS", "perc_identity", "ppos"), names(Orthologs))
)

# ============================================================
# Build one common table for predictor deltas only
#   - do NOT require all outcomes here
# ============================================================
DT_common <- copy(Orthologs)

predictor_required_cols <- c(
  "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  paste0("Celegans_", analysis_features),
  paste0("Ppacificus_", analysis_features)
)

predictor_required_cols <- intersect(predictor_required_cols, names(DT_common))

DT_common <- DT_common[complete.cases(DT_common[, ..predictor_required_cols])]

if (nrow(DT_common) < 10) {
  stop("Too few complete cases after filtering predictor columns.")
}

# ============================================================
# Compute delta features once on the common predictor set
# ============================================================
for (feat in analysis_features) {
  ce_col <- paste0("Celegans_", feat)
  pp_col <- paste0("Ppacificus_", feat)

  DT_common[, paste0("rank_ce_", feat) := rank(get(ce_col), ties.method = "average")]
  DT_common[, paste0("rank_pp_", feat) := rank(get(pp_col), ties.method = "average")]

  DT_common[, paste0("pct_ce_", feat) := get(paste0("rank_ce_", feat)) / .N]
  DT_common[, paste0("pct_pp_", feat) := get(paste0("rank_pp_", feat)) / .N]

  DT_common[, paste0("delta_", feat) := get(paste0("pct_pp_", feat)) - get(paste0("pct_ce_", feat))]
}

DT_common[, delta_mut :=
  rank(Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average") / .N -
  rank(Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average") / .N
]

# ============================================================
# Function: one outcome vs all feature deltas
# ============================================================
run_feature_vs_outcome <- function(DT_in, outcome_name, analysis_features, results_dir) {
  summary_list <- list()

  for (feat in analysis_features) {
    x_col <- paste0("delta_", feat)

    if (!all(c(x_col, outcome_name) %in% names(DT_in))) {
      next
    }

    keep <- complete.cases(DT_in[, c(x_col, outcome_name), with = FALSE])
    DT <- DT_in[keep]

    if (nrow(DT) < 10) {
      next
    }

    x <- DT[[x_col]]
    y <- DT[[outcome_name]]

    # Spearman
    cor_test <- suppressWarnings(
      cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    )

    # Trend / binning tests
    kw_p <- NA_real_
    jt_p <- NA_real_
    wilcox_p <- NA_real_

    qs <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)))

    if (length(qs) >= 2) {
      grp_tmp <- cut_number(x, 5)
      grp_tmp <- factor(grp_tmp, ordered = TRUE, levels = levels(grp_tmp))

      kw_test <- tryCatch(
        kruskal.test(y ~ grp_tmp),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      jt_test <- tryCatch(
        clinfun::jonckheere.test(y, grp_tmp, alternative = "two.sided"),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (!is.null(kw_test)) kw_p <- kw_test$p.value
      if (!is.null(jt_test)) jt_p <- jt_test$p.value

      low <- y[x <= -0.6]
      high <- y[x >= 0.6]

      if (length(low) > 0 && length(high) > 0) {
        wilcox_p <- tryCatch(
          wilcox.test(low, high)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      }
    }

    summary_list[[feat]] <- data.table(
      outcome = outcome_name,
      feature = feat,
      n = nrow(DT),
      spearman_rho = as.numeric(cor_test$estimate),
      spearman_p = cor_test$p.value,
      wilcox_p = wilcox_p,
      kw_p = kw_p,
      jonckheere_p = jt_p
    )
  }

  summary_dt_outcome <- rbindlist(summary_list, fill = TRUE)

  fwrite(
    summary_dt_outcome,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("summary_", outcome_name, ".csv"))
  )

  summary_dt_outcome
}

# ============================================================
# Run all outcomes, including delta_mut
# ============================================================
outcome_summaries <- lapply(outcomes, function(out) {
  message("Processing outcome: ", out)
  run_feature_vs_outcome(DT_common, out, analysis_features, results_dir)
})

outcome_summaries <- Filter(Negate(is.null), outcome_summaries)

if (length(outcome_summaries) == 0) {
  stop("No outcome summaries were generated.")
}

summary_all_outcomes <- rbindlist(outcome_summaries, fill = TRUE)

fwrite(summary_all_outcomes, file.path(results_dir, "summary_all_outcomes.csv"))

summary_all_outcomes
```

```{r Full Outcomes Results Bar Plot}
# ============================================================
# Comparison plot across outcomes:
#   - Mutation-driven: delta_mut, dS
#   - Selection-driven: dNdS
#   - Overall divergence: dN, perc_identity, ppos
#
# This uses summary_all_outcomes and labels features as Delta ...
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

plot_dt <- as.data.frame(summary_all_outcomes) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = paste0("Delta ", str_replace_all(feature, "_", " "), " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
    outcome_label = case_when(
      outcome == "delta_mut"      ~ paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      outcome == "dS"             ~ "dS",
      outcome == "dN"             ~ "dN",
      outcome == "dNdS"           ~ "dN/dS",
      outcome == "perc_identity"  ~ "% identity",
      outcome == "ppos"           ~ "% positives",
      TRUE                        ~ outcome
    ),
    outcome_group = case_when(
      outcome %in% c("delta_mut", "dS") ~ "Mutation-driven",
      outcome == "dNdS"                 ~ "Selection-driven",
      outcome %in% c("dN", "perc_identity", "ppos") ~ "Overall divergence",
      TRUE                              ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Keep only the outcomes you want in the final comparison
plot_dt <- plot_dt %>%
  filter(outcome_group != "Other") %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_group = factor(
      outcome_group,
      levels = c("Mutation-driven", "Selection-driven", "Overall divergence")
    ),
    outcome_label = factor(outcome_label, levels = unique(outcome_label))
  )

# Define column order explicitly
outcome_order <- c(
  paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
  "dS",
  "dN/dS",
  "dN",
  "% identity",
  "% positives"
)

outcome_order <- outcome_order[outcome_order %in% levels(plot_dt$outcome_label)]
plot_dt$outcome_label <- factor(plot_dt$outcome_label, levels = outcome_order)

# Order rows by overall absolute effect size
row_order <- plot_dt %>%
  group_by(feature_label) %>%
  summarise(score = median(abs(spearman_rho), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(score)) %>%
  pull(feature_label)

# Build rho matrix
rho_mat <- plot_dt %>%
  select(feature_label, outcome_label, spearman_rho) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = outcome_label, values_from = spearman_rho) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_label") %>%
  as.matrix()

rho_mat <- rho_mat[row_order, outcome_order, drop = FALSE]

# Build p-value matrix
p_mat <- plot_dt %>%
  select(feature_label, outcome_label, spearman_p) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = outcome_label, values_from = spearman_p) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("feature_label") %>%
  as.matrix()

p_mat <- p_mat[row_order, outcome_order, drop = FALSE]

# Mask non-significant p-values (> 0.05), but keep clustering/ordering safe by not clustering
p_mat_log <- -log10(pmax(p_mat, 1e-300))
p_mat_log[p_mat > 0.05] <- NA
p_mat_log <- pmin(p_mat_log, 50)

# Outcome groups in the same order as columns
outcome_group_vec <- plot_dt %>%
  distinct(outcome_label, outcome_group) %>%
  mutate(outcome_label = factor(outcome_label, levels = outcome_order)) %>%
  arrange(outcome_label) %>%
  pull(outcome_group) %>%
  as.character()

full_spearmanBarPlot <-
  ggplot(
    data = plot_dt,
    aes(x = feature_label, y = spearman_rho, fill = -log10(spearman_p))
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("yellow", "orange", "red", "#8B0000"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(1, 2, 5, 20)),
    name = expression(-log[10](p))
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Spearman coefficient",
    title = "Spearman coefficients by feature"
  ) +
  facet_grid(~outcome_label)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "full_spearman_barplot.png"),
  plot = full_spearmanBarPlot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "transparent"
)

full_spearmanBarPlot

# Colour functions
col_fun_rho <- colorRamp2(
```
